data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 claims incurred, net of reinsurance, in the technical account of GBP 145,382k (2013: GBP 135,871k) includes GBP 34,490k (2013: GBP 51,518k) of releases in respect of prior accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 546.743m. The syndicate reports net releases on prior accident years of GBP 34.49m in 2014 (reported within claims incurred, net of reinsurance), representing a net improvement equal to approximately 6.3% of opening gross reserves. The report attributes the favourable movement to beneficial development of existing reserves and benign catastrophe activity together with disciplined underwriting.
raw_causal_phrases: includes GBP 34,490k (2013: GBP 51,518k) of releases in respect of prior accident years.
was not significantly impacted by any notable industry losses in 2014 except in Aviation

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No gross movement in prior years (gross 'movement in prior year's provision') or gross claims development triangle was found in the disclosed notes. The only explicit quantified prior-year figure is stated as part of 'claims incurred, net of reinsurance' ("includes GBP 34,490k ... of releases in respect of prior accident years") and therefore is NET of reinsurance. Per instructions this NET figure has been used as a last-resort fallback and flagged accordingly. No per-line gross prior year movements were available.
